changelog.notes: Legacy trial exported from Video-based Product Ranking Tool (VPRT) survey records into release schema v2.0.

study.title: Video-based product concept testing of sorghum seed products, Tanzania
study.description: Farmers watched short videos presenting three of the product concepts, assigned at random (incomplete block design), and named the concept they would most and least like to acquire. Part of 'Video-based Product Ranking Tool (VPRT) as a basis for groundnut, maize, and sorghum market segmentation' (CIMMYT market intelligence, v1.1, 2025-04-29). Source data: Mbugua M, Rutsaert P, Mawia H (2024). Using a Video-based Product Ranking Tool (VPRT) as a basis for market segmentation in Tanzania (Sorghum). CIMMYT Research Data & Software Repository Network, V1. https://hdl.handle.net/11529/10549129
study.objective: market segmentation and product profile design

location_privacy.method: Site coordinates rounded to two decimals (a cell of about 1.1 km), so the published point lies within 800 m of the recorded one and neighbouring sites share a point. Sites without coordinates take the mean of other sites in the same adm3 before rounding.
location_privacy.admin_names: Administrative names kept, with spacing and capitalisation standardised

data_producer.name: International Maize and Wheat Improvement Center (CIMMYT)

genotypes.description: 'Feed and Food'. Grain with improved protein for feeding chickens and pigs or selling to feed processors, also usable as food with less attention to cooking quality. Not for fodder or malting.
'Food and fodder'. Big soft leaves and stems for fodder at the cost of some grain yield, also usable as food with less attention to cooking quality.
'High yielding hybrid'. About 30% more yield than other improved seed, mainly for sale to grain traders. Seed must be bought every season.
'Food for family'. Cooking quality first, higher iron and zinc, good flour yield, sweet taste in uji or ugali, cooks and threshes easily. 20% less yield than other improved seed.
'Grain for beer'. Large grains demanded by traders and processors for industrial beer making. For income only, not for food, feed or fodder.
'Sorghum and peas'. Performs well intercropped with pigeon pea, cowpea or chickpea, improving soil and diet, but with more labour and harder mechanisation.
'Forage for animals'. Hybrid for livestock feed, harvested before grain maturity at 100-120 days, soft leaves and stems for silage. Not for grain.

Radius in metres around the published point that contains the original point (displacement plus spread of the sites used for gap filling)

Plot letter within the site (A, B, C)
Name of the genotype (variety) in the plot
Data collection moment (form) as named in the trial
Planned day of the collection moment, counted from the start of the trial as set in the trial design (the day of sowing in most designs); the same for every site. The actual date is moment_date

Variable name, harmonised across trials
Identifier of the harmonised question
Question code or label as used in the trial
Value. For value_type rank, 1 is best and 3 is worst
rank, vs_local, numeric, date, categorical, multiple or text

Quality flag (implausible_yield_per_area, outlier_vs_trial_median, unit_unclear, derived)
